  • Bought it because it was 1/2 price of Ruger Redhawk in .45 ACP. Also much lighter than Redhawk.
  • Same barrel cant that SpottyMatt has on 9mm but in the opposite direction. At first it was noticeable and I complained about it in the video. But after a year I don't even notice it anymore.
